en: Address side of an old postcard with the word 'Postkarte' in Gothic type and bilingual Spanish/German prompts. It bears a red Cuban 2 centavos stamp canceled with a circular postmark reading 'HAVANA CUBA JUL 15 190?'. The card is addressed to 'Sr Perez Galdos, Paseo de la Magdalena' in Santander, Spain. Additional printed text includes 'Via Extranjeras', 'An', and 'Wohnung (Straße u. Hausnummer)'.
